data_boundary: 38 MMCSG GeoWearNet-internal validation windows derived only from official train. No Mentra-device audio exists in this environment.

configurations.A_OFFLINE_REF: dense probabilities + offline GeoWearGate (the G3 product-matrix path)
configurations.C_LIVE_PROBS_OFFLINE_GATE: 200 ms held probabilities + offline gate (isolates detector cadence)
configurations.D_LIVE_FULL: real MentraInferenceConsumer + AudioFrontend envelope + PCM16 encode

pcm16_quantisation_only.note: Reported separately so PCM16 rounding is never counted as a routing difference.

detector_cadence_sweep.note: Real-time factor is the WHOLE live path (feature extraction, model, envelope, PCM16 encode) on this shared CPU host at 2 torch threads, measured end to end -- not a model-only microbenchmark. RTF depends only on the cadence, not on the pre-roll, which is why it repeats across pre-roll rows for one hop.
detector_cadence_sweep.state_agreement_caveat: state agreement is measured on the un-shifted gate state sequence, so it is a property of the cadence alone; pre-roll changes WHICH AUDIO a state lands on, not the state sequence itself.
